provenance.source: 本地自建，非上游 AssetOpsBench tsfm MCP server
provenance.tool_names_from: 论文 §A.3 Table 4（aitasks / tsfmmodels / tsfm_forecasting / tsfm forecasting finetune / tsfm integrated tsad）+ §4.3 描述的重采样、工况判定、有限插补、conformal tsad
provenance.model_catalog_basis: 公开 HuggingFace 上真实存在的时序基础模型 checkpoint，不是上游 tsfmmodels 的原始清单（上游清单未公开）
provenance.execution_note: 本机离网且无 GPU 余量加载 HF 权重，forecast/tsad 用确定性本地基线（水平+季节剖面 / 滚动稳健 z 分数）实现，接口与参数对齐上游，数值不代表上游模型输出
provenance.不可声称: 不得称本工具面等同上游 41 个 tsfm 工具，也不得把本模块分数当作上游 TSFM Agent 的复现度

tasks.description: Predict future values of one or more sensor target columns over a horizon.
Fine-tune a pretrained forecasting checkpoint on an asset's own history.
Time-series anomaly detection from model residuals with a calibrated threshold.
Report gaps and apply limited imputation (short gaps only, long gaps left missing).
Align irregular readings to a fixed grid and infer operating periods.

models.description: Tokenizes scaled series into bins and decodes probabilistically; strong zero-shot baseline.
Bolt variant with patched encoder and direct multi-step head; much faster inference.
Decoder-only patched transformer pretrained on a large time-series corpus.
Universal forecaster with any-variate attention; handles multivariate targets jointly.
Tiny time mixer; deliberately small, designed for cheap per-asset fine-tuning.
Lag-based foundation model; lags and horizon are decoupled at inference.
Multi-task foundation model covering forecasting, classification and reconstruction-based detection.
